summary: MaintClinicalPracticeCodes manages the maintenance of Clinical Practice Codes in the HSPnet system. The business process is realized through a web UI with dropdowns for Agency, Department, and Program, a grid showing existing codes, and a popup details panel for editing or creating new codes.
purpose: Allow authorized users to add, edit, delete, and reactivate Clinical Practice Codes related to Programs. Supports filtering, validation, and controlled access based on user permissions.

workflows.name: Add Clinical Practice Code
steps: User selects Agency, Department, Program from dropdowns.
User clicks 'Add' button (enabled only for authorized users and required dropdowns populated).
Detail popup opens for entry.
User enters Name and ShortName (both required, validated).
On Save, system creates new ClinicalPracticeCode linked to Program.
Grid and main panel refresh with new entry.

workflows.name: Edit Clinical Practice Code
steps: User clicks 'Edit' on a grid row.
Detail popup opens populated with selected entry.
User updates Name and/or ShortName.
On Save, system validates and updates the entry.
Grid and main panel refresh.

workflows.name: Delete Clinical Practice Code
steps: User clicks 'Delete' on a grid row.
System prompts for confirmation.
System marks entry as Inactive.
Grid refreshes.

workflows.name: Reactivate Clinical Practice Code
steps: Authorized user clicks 'Reactivate' on an inactive code.
System reactivates entry.
Grid refreshes.

workflows.name: Filter/Search Clinical Practice Codes
steps: User selects Agency, Department, Program, enters search keywords or toggles Show Inactive.
Grid refreshes with matching entries.

business_rules: Name and ShortName are required for each Clinical Practice Code.
Add/Edit/Delete/Reactivate is only allowed if user permission and dropdown selections are valid.
Reactivate is visible only to SystemAdministrators if code is inactive.
No Add allowed if Department or Program dropdowns are empty.
LocalAdministrators can edit only codes for accessible Departments.
validations: Validation group isolating detail panel inputs.
Grid disables edit fields and hides save button when screen is not editable.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is true only for authorized users and required dropdowns populated.
SystemAdministrator and LocalAdministrator branches for access.
Grid and UI elements dynamically enabled/disabled based on ScreenIsEditable.
system_behavior: Grid displays codes filtered by Agency, Department, Program, search keyword, and inactive status.
Popup details panel for add/edit operations.
Validation errors shown via ValidationSummary popups.
Error and warning panels with captions/messages.
RefreshData binds grid to current filters.
Data source (dsCPCodes) uses ObjectDataSource, passing UserSession and filter parameters.
exceptions: If user lacks permission, screen disables add/edit/delete/reactivate and shows read-only messages.
If Department or Program dropdown empty, no add allowed.
If validation fails, error messages shown in detail panel.
